en: A black-and-white image showing a harbor scene with a ship named 'Jürgen' docked by the waterfront. There are two large cranes, industrial warehouses, and residential buildings in the background. The most prominent warehouse features a sign reading 'L. Richter Aktiebolag,' suggesting it is a company building. The overall setting looks like a Northern European port city.
